description: Customers report an account being hacked and seeing a “no token provided” message.
code_definition: account hacked, banned, deleted, lost or stuck in the wrong country/profile

description: Customers say they cannot log in, their password is not accepted, or they are prompted to check their phone number and try again.
code_definition: cannot log in or sign up; password, verification or 'logged out' problems

description: Customers report being unable to complete a Premium purchase or get a payment prompt, and one says they paid but still see a pause subscription screen.
code_definition: wrong or repeated charges, refunds, payment failures, Premium not activating after paying

issue_name: Basic Music Controls Locked Behind Premium
description: Customers say basic listening controls and features, including skips, ordered playback, shuffle controls, queue playback, and rewinding, are limited to Premium. Some also object to paying for better audio quality or say the app pressures them to subscribe.
code_definition: a feature is locked behind Premium or limited on the free tier (choosing a song, skips, rewind, repeat, turning shuffle off), or the app pressures users to buy Premium

description: The customer says Spotify seems to care only about money.
code_definition: price, price increases, plans, value for money

description: A customer says there is not much gospel music available.
code_definition: praise for how much or what kind of music/podcasts is available ("has every song", "huge selection"); not for "great music" in general

issue_name: Lyrics Missing or Failing to Load
description: Customers say lyrics are absent for some songs or fail to load or appear. One customer reports lyrics work on desktop but only for some songs on their phone.
code_definition: lyrics missing, wrong or unavailable

description: Customers say songs are missing or have been removed, and one says only a 30-second clip is available. Another reports that Collab streams for BTS and its members were removed.
code_definition: songs, artists, podcasts, videos or languages missing, removed or unavailable

description: Customers report receiving unwanted or excessive recommendations, including songs they already have in playlists and music that repeats.
code_definition: recommendations, discovery, search, generated mixes, unwanted suggested songs

description: Customers report that offline listening does not work, downloaded music is gone, or downloads get stuck. One customer says a storage move failed and deleted everything.
code_definition: downloads fail, disappear or will not play offline

description: Customers express boycott or protest sentiments and objections tied to Sweden, religion, or support for LGBTQ people. One comment criticizes the app for being bad for smaller artists.
code_definition: political, religious, ethical or boycott statements that are not about how the product works

description: Customers broadly describe the app as bad, useless, or disappointing. The sampled quotes do not identify a specific feature or problem.
code_definition: general praise or criticism with no specific feature

description: A customer reports hearing unpleasant noise during playback.
code_definition: sound quality or volume problems

description: Customers report no-internet errors, trouble connecting to or casting playback on other devices, and songs failing to play or changing unexpectedly during playback.
code_definition: 'no internet connection' errors, or playback via bluetooth, car, cast, speaker, watch, another device or a voice assistant

issue_name: App Crashes or Gets Stuck Loading
description: Customers report the app crashing during use, failing to open, or getting stuck on a loading or black screen.
code_definition: app crashes, freezes, will not open or is stuck loading

description: Customers report that some podcasts lag during playback and that the app uses excessive mobile data and phone storage.
code_definition: lag, slowness, battery, storage or mobile-data use

issue_name: Playback Stops or Fails to Start
description: Customers say music or podcasts stop or pause unexpectedly, including partway through playback. Some say they cannot get songs to play at all.
code_definition: music or podcasts will not play, stop, pause, buffer, skip or restart by themselves

description: Customers report frequent or lengthy ads, including multiple ads before or between songs. Some say the ads are loud or irritating.
code_definition: too many, too long, too loud or badly timed ads

issue_name: Shuffle and Playback Controls Behave Unexpectedly
description: Customers report trouble adding songs to the queue or playing the songs they choose. Shuffle and autoplay may play unexpected or repeated tracks, and some say playback controls do not work properly.
code_definition: shuffle, skip, repeat, queue, playlist editing, autoplay or voice controls that work badly, NOT described as a Premium-only restriction

issue_name: Home Screen Navigation and Missing Features
description: Customers say daily mixes were removed from the home page or are harder to find, and that updates changed the home screen or left features missing. Some also describe the app as less user-friendly.
code_definition: layout, navigation, redesigns, home screen, notifications, widgets, removed interface features
